answer: To secure an economy of AI agents against Sybil attacks, the nebula protocol requires each node to solve computationally intensive proof-of-work benchmarks. This mechanism, named raven, forces an attacker to expend vast hardware resources to spawn fake identities. By tying agent voting weight to a scarce cryptographic reputation token called jade, the network ensures that generating sub-identities yields no economic advantage, raising the cost of subversion beyond any potential payoff.
